nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Iterates every non-weekend day from today to April 30 2026 across all sede-persona combinations, checking for existing appointments and inserting 'UFF CHIUSO' placeholders for free slots.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Accepts a SQL string from the request body, executes it against PostgreSQL via the shared query helper, and returns rows with row count or an error response.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Validates the requested table name exists in the public schema, then fetches up to 100 rows from that table and returns them as JSON.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Queries information_schema.tables to list all public PostgreSQL table names and returns them as a JSON array.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route handler for the 'agende' (agendas) resource. Exposes GET (list all agendas from PostgreSQL, with static fallback if table missing), POST (create a new agenda), and PUT (toggle active status) endpoints. Manages three built-in agenda types: 730, EPASA, and Sale Riunioni.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lists all agendas ordered by name, with a fallback to a hardcoded DEFAULT_AGENDE list if the database table does not exist yet.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new agenda entry. Requires id and nome fields; returns 400 if missing, 503 if table not yet created.

nodes.name: PUT
nodes.summary: Updates the active status of an agenda identified by id. Returns 404 if not found.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Dynamic Next.js API route for individual 730-agenda appointment operations. Handles PUT (update appointment fields, normalize dates, log to activity_log, broadcast SSE) and DELETE (remove appointment, log to activity_log, broadcast SSE). Skips logging for 'UFF CHIUSO' entries.

nodes.name: PUT
nodes.summary: Updates an appointment by id. Validates required fields, normalizes date/time formats from DB, writes to activity_log (non-blocking), and broadcasts SSE update.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Deletes an appointment by id. Fetches the record first for logging, then deletes, writes to activity_log (non-blocking), and broadcasts SSE update.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint for the 730 agenda. Opens a persistent streaming response, registers the client controller via lib/sse, sends an initial 'connected' event, and deregisters on disconnect.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Creates and returns a ReadableStream SSE response, managing client registration lifecycle via add730Client/remove730Client.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for the 730-agenda appointments collection. GET lists all appointments optionally filtered by month/year with date normalization. POST creates a new appointment with validation, normalization, activity logging, and SSE broadcast.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Fetches all appointments, optionally filtered by mese/anno query params. Normalizes date and time fields before returning.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new appointment with full field validation, date normalization, non-blocking activity log write, and SSE broadcast.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route that serves the activity log (cronologia). GET ensures the activity_log table exists, then returns a paginated, filterable list of log entries supporting filters by source, action, and text search. Returns total, totalPages, page, limit, and hasMore metadata.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Lazily creates activity_log table if missing, then queries it with dynamic WHERE conditions for source, action, and text search. Returns paginated results with metadata.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Dynamic Next.js API route for individual EPASA appointment operations. Provides GET (fetch by id), PUT (update with SSE broadcast and activity log), and DELETE (remove with SSE broadcast and activity log). Uses a local normalizeApt helper to normalize date/time fields.

nodes.name: normalizeApt
nodes.summary: Helper that normalizes an EPASA appointment row: formats date as 'yyyy-MM-dd' and trims time to HH:mm.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Fetches a single EPASA appointment by id, returns 404 if not found.

nodes.name: PUT
nodes.summary: Updates an EPASA appointment by id, broadcasts SSE update, and logs the action via logActivity.

nodes.name: DELETE
nodes.summary: Deletes an EPASA appointment by id, broadcasts SSE update, and logs the action via logActivity.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js API route for the EPASA appointments collection. GET lists all EPASA appointments ordered by date with date normalization. POST creates a new EPASA appointment with validation, normalization, SSE broadcast, and activity logging.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Fetches all EPASA appointments ordered by date, normalizing date and ora fields.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new EPASA appointment with required field validation, broadcasts SSE update, and logs activity.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint for the EPASA agenda. Opens a persistent streaming response, registers the client via lib/sse (addEpasaClient), sends an initial 'connected' event, and removes the client on disconnect.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Creates and returns a ReadableStream SSE response for EPASA clients, managing lifecycle via addEpasaClient/removeEpasaClient.

nodes.name: POST

nodes.label: AgendeManager.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings panel component for managing persona-sede associations (agendas). Loads persons, locations and their links from the API, renders them in a table, and provides a modal form to create or delete associations via /api/persona-sede.
nodes.name: components/settings/AgendeManager.tsx

nodes.label: log.ts
nodes.summary: Server-side activity logging utility. Exports LogAction and LogSource types, and the logActivity function which auto-creates the activity_log table if absent and inserts structured records. Errors are swallowed to avoid blocking the caller.
nodes.name: lib/log.ts

nodes.label: postgres.ts
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL connection pool module using the pg library. Configures a pool of 5–20 connections from environment variables, exports a typed query() helper with timing logs, a getClient() for manual transactions, and the pool itself as default export.
nodes.name: lib/postgres.ts

nodes.label: sse.ts
nodes.summary: Global SSE (Server-Sent Events) manager for three independent channels: EPASA agenda, Sala Riunioni (meeting room), and Agenda 730. Uses global Sets of ReadableStreamDefaultController to survive hot-reload; exports add/remove/broadcast helpers for each channel.
nodes.name: lib/sse.ts

nodes.label: AppointmentCell
nodes.summary: Internal sub-component rendering a single draggable appointment card with color highlighting, time range display, and a portal-rendered tooltip for notes on hover.
nodes.name: AppointmentCell

nodes.label: TimeSlot
nodes.summary: Main exported component. Computes column layout for overlapping appointments, calculates slot heights based on time range, and delegates rendering to AppointmentCell. Falls back to a clickable empty cell when no appointments start at this time.
nodes.name: TimeSlot

nodes.label: UpdateBanner
nodes.summary: React component that sets up a 60-second polling interval to compare buildId from /api/version and shows a dismissible update banner when a new version is detected.
nodes.name: UpdateBanner

nodes.label: AgendeManager
nodes.summary: Settings component managing persona-sede agenda associations. Fetches and joins data from three APIs (/api/persona-sede, /api/persone, /api/sedi), renders a table, and provides modal-driven create/delete operations.
nodes.name: AgendeManager

nodes.label: NotificheManager
nodes.summary: Settings component for notification management. Displays a hardcoded list of past notifications with type-based icons and colors, plus a modal form for composing new ones (send is stubbed).
nodes.name: NotificheManager

nodes.label: PersoneManager
nodes.summary: Settings component for CRUD operations on Persona records. Distinguishes create vs. update mode by checking editingPersona state, calls appropriate HTTP method on /api/persone or /api/persone/:id.
nodes.name: PersoneManager

nodes.label: SediManager
nodes.summary: Settings component for CRUD operations on Sede records. Includes detailed error parsing from API responses and debug logging. Calls /api/sedi and /api/sedi/:id for all operations.
nodes.name: SediManager

nodes.label: logActivity
params: params: { source: LogSource; action: LogAction; descrizione: string; dettagli?: object; }
nodes.summary: Async function that idempotently creates the activity_log table and inserts a structured log entry. All errors are caught and logged to console to prevent disruption of the calling operation.
nodes.name: logActivity

nodes.label: query
nodes.summary: Typed async query wrapper around pool.query() that logs query text, duration and row count on success, or re-throws on error.
nodes.name: query

nodes.label: getClient
nodes.summary: Returns a raw pg PoolClient for use in manual transactions.
nodes.name: getClient

nodes.label: broadcastEpasaUpdate
nodes.summary: Encodes and enqueues an SSE message to all connected EPASA clients. Automatically removes stale controllers that throw on enqueue.
nodes.name: broadcastEpasaUpdate

nodes.label: broadcastRoomUpdate
nodes.summary: Encodes and enqueues an SSE message to all connected Sala Riunioni clients. Stale controllers are pruned after iteration.
nodes.name: broadcastRoomUpdate

nodes.label: broadcast730Update
nodes.summary: Encodes and enqueues an SSE message to all connected Agenda 730 clients. Stale controllers are pruned after iteration.
nodes.name: broadcast730Update

getWeekDays
nodes.summary: Returns an array of 7 Date objects representing a full week (Mon–Sun) for the week containing the given date, using Monday as week start.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Formats a Date to ISO yyyy-MM-dd string for use as a database/API key.

nodes.name: formatDateDisplay
nodes.summary: Formats a Date to Italian locale display string (e.g. 'lunedì 23/03') for calendar headers.

nodes.name: getTimeSlotsForSede
nodes.summary: Returns the correct start-time slot array for a given location name/id, date, and optional agenda context. Handles Imola (LMM/Thu/Fri splits), Borgo/CSPT (weekday-only), and special Saturday exception slots for Agenda 730.

nodes.name: getEndTimeSlotsForSede
nodes.summary: Returns the correct end-time slot array for a given location, mirroring getTimeSlotsForSede but including the closing slot (e.g. 18:00 or 12:30).

nodes.name: isSedeWorkingDay
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given date is a working day for a sede. Normally Mon–Fri only; for Agenda 730 allows the three exceptional Saturdays defined in SABATI_730_ECCEZIONE.
